6:30 AM — where it starts

I'm Kiran Gill — and I've stood where you're standing.

Before any of this was a job, it was my own kitchen at 3am, phone in hand, googling the same questions you might be googling right now. My own toddler taught me that "sleep training" and "just breastfeed, it's natural" are both a lot more complicated than the internet makes them sound.

That's what sent me back to school — I'm now a certified sleep consultant through the Institute of Pediatric Sleep, and a Certified Lactation Counselor (CLC) through ALPP. I wanted the credentials to back up what I'd already learned the hard way.

"You don't need someone with all the answers. You need someone who won't leave you to figure it out alone."
